candidates.requirement: The scanner target must reach scanning behavior with the supported, configurable maximum nesting level.
candidates.target_route: Set the limit with yaml_set_max_nest_level, then scan a YAML flow collection through the target's existing string-input and scan loop.
candidates.failure_condition: With the supported limit set to 2000, 1001 balanced nested flow sequences can pass the added depth guard. The complete old target never sets the limit, so its default of 1000 rejects that same input at the 1001st opening bracket.
candidates.alternative_paths: Input bytes do not set the global limit. The complete target has no other setup call or scan route; every invocation retains the default limit.
